# Kitchen garden

Four raised beds behind the house, one compost bay and a greenhouse that
leaks. This vault keeps what worked, what did not, and when to sow.

> [!tip] Where to begin
> Read [[Planting calendar]] first, then the notes on [[Tomatoes]] and
> [[Compost]]. Pests have a folder of their own: [[Aphids]], [[Slugs]].

## This week

- [x] Turn the compost bay
- [ ] Pot on the tomato seedlings
- [ ] Order more [[Beans|runner beans]]
- [ ] Net the brassicas against #pests

## Beds

| Bed | Crop      | Sown       |
| --- | --------- | ---------- |
| 1   | Tomatoes  | 14 April   |
| 2   | Beans     | 2 May      |
| 3   | Lettuce   | every 3 wk |
| 4   | Fallow    |            |
